recommendations.rationale: Timing sequence features are PRIMARY separators. Boost: ['compression_days_pre', 'days_from_breakout_to_peak']. Reduce: ['days_from_first_compression_to_breakout', 'dryup_day_count_pre', 'days_in_base', 'days_from_first_abnormal_volume_to_breakout'].

Duration metrics (compression_days_pre, atr_contraction_days_pre) separate better than the binary had_compression. had_compression is always-on — use day count instead. Boost: ['compression_days_pre'].

Volume anomaly is useful but needs calibration. dryup_day_count_pre (quiet before storm) is often a better signal than raw max_volume_anomaly. Boost: ['abnormal_volume_day_count_pre']. Reduce: ['max_volume_anomaly_pre', 'median_volume_anomaly_pre', 'dryup_day_count_pre'].

Wyckoff structure quality (accumulation_like_day_count, had_spring_test_lps, reclaim_bar_count_pre) are primary separators. had_accumulation_like binary may be always-on — prefer day_count. Boost: ['reclaim_bar_count_pre'].
EMA ribbon episode fields available. Boost: ['bull_stack_days_pre']. Delta bonuses deferred — delta feature extraction not yet in pipeline.

Single-bar candle anatomy (body_pct, wick_pct) rarely separates 4x_pump from sub-4x winners. Scanner v2 priority_scorer already excludes these. Confirmed low-signal: ['avg_body_pct_pre', 'avg_upper_wick_pct_pre', 'avg_lower_wick_pct_pre', 'bearish_engulfing_count_pre', 'inside_bar_count_pre', 'outside_bar_count_pre'].

Scanner v2 structural signals (L34 setup, G4 trigger, B2 confirm, d_confluence type, structure_phase, compression_expansion_state). Promote features that separate 4x_pump from false_positive in the NP signal chain. Confirm_after_g4 and isolated signals are late/noisy — reduce.

summary.note: Deterministic plan — no AI. Based on comparison medians only. Validate counts per group before applying to Scanner v2. Targets: d_confluence weights, structure_score thresholds, compression_expansion_state gates, expansion_timing_risk filters.
